question: How does admin assign shared expenses?

sections.title: Assign shared responsibility through trip participants
sections.beforeHtml: Shared expenses are no longer assigned from individual expense rows. Admins assign shared responsibility by setting each participant`s shared amount and optional deadline.
items: Open Dashboard > Trip personal > Participants for the selected trip.
Select the participant you want to update and open Update.
Enter the participant`s Shared amount and, if needed, set a Shared deadline.
Submit the form. Plantour saves that participant`s shared assignment immediately.
Set the shared amount back to 0 if you want to remove the participant`s current shared assignment.

sections.title: Use shared expenses and participants together
items: Use the Trip shared expenses page to maintain the trip-level list of shared costs.
Use the Trip participants page to decide how much of that shared cost is assigned to each participant.
The shared-expenses overview shows whether the trip-level total and participant assignments stay in sync.
Trip info and reports summarize the shared assigned, paid, remaining, pending, and rejected values across participants.
sections.afterHtml: Participants do not accept or reject shared expenses on the shared-expenses page. They respond to their assigned shared amount from the Trip participants page and then record shared payments on the personal Trip expenses page.
